rationale: Seed the design-critique-agent (migration 645) — Phase 1 of features_open/018, owner-directed 2026-08-25 to build in the leopardess lane, following the vigilant_designer Phase 2 shape and its four recorded owner decisions (manual cadence; designer first; trial both models — Gemini per the 2026-07-24 owner call; broad autonomy). The Go half (storage grant, Council-Submitted 30d5fdde, commit 04c49f8f0) is LIVE on the running chassis — capability-probed 2026-08-26 with a positive and negative control in the same exec — so the 243 ordering trap does not apply. The seed is one INSERT of a new agent type, idempotent, no trigger wired: manual dispatch is the only path in, per the recorded owner decision. The central design property, stated in the owner-approved plan: auto-filed work items draw ONLY from the browser's deterministic measurements (write_render_audit_findings, the proven seed-301 drain, run BEFORE the vision call so a failed critique never costs the measured findings), while the vision model's taste output lands ONLY in a doc_notes report whose declared reader is the owner — the split is enforced by workflow topology, not prompt wording, because on 2026-08-19 four of five LLM design findings were false and minutes from auto-dispatching a repaint of a correct palette. load_design_context reads the LIVE palette via sites->style_collections->css_themes->palettes plus site_specs.design_intent (join verified live for leopardess: leopardess-dark-gold, 22 colour keys) — deliberately NOT style_collections.color_palette, whose seed defaults are why visual-design-auditor called a dark-gold site corporate blue. Every action named is registered and live; capture_renders:true is that flag's first live use; max_images 16 is set explicitly rather than inherited. Registered as SQ-003 in the same commit.

plan.summary: One new migration, sql_for_agents/645_design_critique_agent.sql: INSERT design-critique-agent into agent_definitions with an 8-step workflow (ensure_site_record -> request_render_audit capture_renders:true -> write_render_audit_findings -> query_database design context -> execute_vision_prompt Gemini -> append_doc_note design-report -> terminals), idempotent via WHERE NOT EXISTS, with an in-transaction DO/RAISE verification (exactly 1 row, exactly 8 steps). No trigger, no cron, no promoter pair: manual dispatch only.

edits.rationale: The whole change: a new agent definition composed entirely of proven parts — 145's INSERT shape, 317's execute_vision_prompt + append_doc_note step configs (artefact-defusal preamble reused), 301's write_render_audit_findings config, query_database with $1 params. The only novelties are the step ORDER (measured findings before the vision call, so the deterministic half can never be lost to a vision failure — the 317 lesson made structural) and the corrected design-context query.
edits.sketch: INSERT INTO agent_definitions (type, ..., default_config) SELECT 'design-critique-agent', ..., '{workflow: {start_step: ensure_site_record, steps: {ensure_site_record -> audit (request_render_audit, capture_renders true, max_pages 8) -> file_measured_findings (write_render_audit_findings, site_id site_record.site_id) -> load_design_context (query_database, live-palette join + design_intent, params [site_record.site_id]) -> critique (execute_vision_prompt, images_field render_audit, max_images 16, gemini/gemini-pro-latest/GEMINI_API_KEY, taste prompt judged against design_context, error_step complete_no_critique) -> write_report (append_doc_note, pipeline/design-critique, categories [design-report]) -> complete; terminals complete_no_critique (SUCCESS: findings stand without a report), complete_error}}}' WHERE NOT EXISTS (...); DO $$ ... RAISE on row count <> 1 or step count <> 8 ... $$;

grounded_in: Capability probe, 2026-08-26, running chassis pod: grep -aq 'design-critique-agent' /proc/1/exe PRESENT; 'tool-acceptance-agent' PRESENT (positive control); 'zzz_invented_string_xq9' absent (negative control).

seed 317 header: 'A FAILED LOOK IS NOT A FAILED ACCEPTANCE RUN. Both new steps route error_step to complete_no_look — a SUCCESS terminal' — the pattern this seed's complete_no_critique reuses, strengthened by running the measured-findings drain before the vision call.

write_render_audit_findings_action.go header: files contrast_failure at css-patch-agent and undeployed_asset at asset-deployer with co-deduping keys — 'the shared namespace is the point' — so a second producer beside render-audit-agent's rotation is the drain's designed-for pattern.

Live join verified 2026-08-26: SELECT sc.name, p2.name, count colour keys FROM sites s JOIN style_collections sc ... JOIN css_themes ct ... JOIN palettes p2 ... WHERE s.id='4851f6fc-...' -> leopardess-dark-gold | leopardess-dark-gold | 22.

Owner-approved plan Part B: 'The split must be enforced by where a finding comes from, not by a category label a future prompt edit could mislabel' and 'Nothing auto-files until the report has been read once and judged useful' — honoured: the vision output is wired to append_doc_note only.

Chassis pod env, 2026-08-26: GEMINI_API_KEY SET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY SET, IMAGE_BUCKET correctly UNSET on the shared deployment (the grant supplies it to the spawned pod — the 2026-08-08 ruling's design).
plan.risks: The seed is live the moment it applies, but the agent is unreachable except by manual dispatch (no trigger, no promoter pair, nothing emits for it) — blast radius until someone hand-fires it is zero. First-run risks, all observable: (1) the spawned pod must actually receive IMAGE_BUCKET — the grant's first behavioural proof; if it does not, the run fails 'no storage client' loudly and the verdict is on the orchestration row; (2) execute_vision_prompt has never run against provider gemini in production (the doc-comment config shape is followed; the model trial is a recorded owner decision, so a Claude fallback is one config edit); (3) write_render_audit_findings becomes a second producer on contrast_failure/undeployed_asset keys — co-dedup absorbs duplicates by design, but a reviewer should confirm the dedup key shapes really are identical to render-audit-agent's (same action, same config shape, so they are the same code path). The discrimination control is pre-planned: run once before the leopardess hero batch is wired (the report should remark on hero sameness) and once after (that finding must move while the rest stays stable) — a critic reporting identically across a real visual change is measuring nothing.
